tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba bzhugs/

oṃ swā sti/ dpag yas rgyal ba'i mthu stobs gcig bsdus pa/ /bcom ldan rdo rje 'dzin par gus btud nas/ /gang de'i sgrub thabs gru chen legs bzung ste/ /byin rlabs rgya mtsho'i klaung du 'jug par bya/ /de la dkyil 'khor chen po 'di nyid kyi dbang bskur ba thob cing dam tshig dang ldan pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed rdor sems sgom bzlas rnams spyi dang mthun par bya ba las/ 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdug bsngal kun gyi gnas gyur pa'i/ /'khor ba'i 'dam nas gtso bos drongs/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag dang = sogs brjod pa ni khyad par ro/ / rang skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das phyag na rdo rje'i skur gsal ba'i thugs kar nyi ma la gnas pa'i hūṃ nag po de las bh+ruṃ yig cig spros pa mdun gyi nam mkhar rin po che'i rang bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor sngon po 'dzam bu'i gling gi dbyibs can du gyur/ yang paṃ gcig 'phros pa las/ de'i steng du pad+ma 'dab ma bzhi pa zla ba'i gdan lnga dang bcas par gyur/ hū ཾ las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros/ bla ma dang yid dam gyi lha dang mkha' dbyings gang ba'i dkon mchog rgya mtsho'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs te gdan la bzhugs par gyur/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ dbus su rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang gi rnam pa can/ na mo badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍa la de be bh+yaḥ shar du yi dam/ na mo budha ya/ lhor sangs rgyas/ na mo dharmā ya/ nub tu dam chos/ na moḥsad+gha ya/ byang du dge 'dun rnams so/ / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyasathams cad dang */ /dkyil 'khor gsang ba'i lha tshogs dang*/ /byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ /sgo gsum dad pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra pā ṇi maṇ+ḍal de be bh+yaḥ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā t+yaṃ añtsa ma naṃ/ me tog sogs la sngags kyi mgo 'dra ba la/ badz+ra puṣ+pe pu dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye hū ཾ/ de bzhin du/

badz+ra dhu pe= ā lo ke= gan+dhe= n+yai we te/ shap+ta= zhes sbyor/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun la/ /mchod pa bla na med pas mchod/ /'khor ba thog ma med pa nas/ /'tshams med lnga dang nye ba lnga/ /mi dge bcu dang lci ba brgyad/ kha na ma tho la sogs pa/ /'phags pa'i tshogs la so sor bshags/ /'jig rten dge bcu ji snyed dang*/ /nyan thos rang rgyal dge 'dun bcas/ /rgyal ba sras bcas 'gro don mdzad/ /de dag la ni yi rang ngo*/ /phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas zhing khams na/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ /ring po ma lon thams cad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bskul/ /'khor ba ji srid ma stongs par/ /mya ngan mi 'da' gsol ba 'debs/ /dge bcu ji snyed spyod pa dang*/ / bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi rnams dang*/pha rol phyin pa bcu la sogs/ /byang chub chen por bsngo bar bgyi/ /bdag gi lus 'di ji srid du/ /len pa rdo rje slob dpon dang*/ /'khor lo chen po'i lha tshogs dang*/ /sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa la/ /bdag yid dang bas dbul bar bgyi/ /rkang gnyis gtso bo sangs rgyas dang*/ /'dod chags bral ba'i chos rnams dang*/ /tshogs kyi zhing gyur dge 'dun la/ /dad pa'i sems kyis skyabs su mchi/ /byang chub mchog gi rang bzhin can/ /sems can kun la khyab par gnas/ /ma rtogs 'khor bar 'khyams pa rnams/ /de dag don du sems bskyed do/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas sras bcas pas/ /bslab dang slob par 'gyur ba yi/ /sems can don byed tshul khrims dang*/ /sdom pa'i tshul khrims ldan pa dang */ /dge ba chos sdud tshul khrims rnams/ /yang dag blangs te gnas par bgyi/ /dus 'di nyid nas bzung nas ni/ /'khor ba'i nyes pas ma gos par/ /mchod pa kun dang ldan par ni/ / dus kun du ni bde bar mnos/ / so so'am breng chags su lan gsum mo/ / rgyas pa la dga' na/ maṇ+ḍal dang mchod pa bsham/ bsangs sbyangs/ byin rlabs mchod pa'i tshigs bcad sogs kyang brjod do/

/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang = zhes pa nas/ gnas par gyur cig gi bar tshad med bzhi spyi mthun ltar 'don/ oṃ shun+ya ta dzña na badz+ra swa bhā wa at+ma konyahaṃ/ lan gsum/ de dag ni sngon 'gro'o/ / stong pa'i ngang las rang sems hū ཾ yig mthing nag nam mkhar gnas par gyur/ de las raṃ chad pa la nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor/ hūṃ chad pa las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba mthing nag hūṃ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi rwa ba dra ba gur bla re phyi rol ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ lan gsum/ gzhung las/ rlung dang chu'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du srung 'khor bsgom par bshad kyang da lta lag len la mi mdzad do// yang hū ཾ ཿlas e chad pa las chos kyi 'byung gnas phyi dkar la nang dmar ba gdengs ka gyen du bstan pa/ rgya khyon dpag tu med par gyur/ hūṃ las yaṃ raṃ baṃ laṃ rnams chad chos 'byung gi nang du rim pas 'khod/ yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam sngon po ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po me lce gsum gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po bu ma pas mtshan pa/ de'i steng du laṃ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po rdo rje phyed pa bzhis mtshan pa'o/ / 'dir bla ma smar chen po 'byung bzhin lugs zlog tu bzhed do/ /'di nyid kyi gzhung las/ lugs 'byung lugs zlog gnyis ka mi gsal mod/ gzhal yas khang gi gdan ma yin par rgyur gtong ba'i rigs la lugs 'byung lugs zlog gang byas kyang mi 'gal zhing*/ /bla ma'i man ngag nyid kyi phyir gnyis kar rung ngo*/ / nam mkha'i hūṃ las bh+ru ཾ zhi ga chad de/ 'byung ba bzhi la thim/ de thams cad gcig tu 'dres pa las/ rten gyi dkyil 'khor gzhal med khang rjes 'brang dang bcas pa grub pa ni/

sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba'i stegs bu la gnas pa'i rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal med khang gru bzhi'i sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin du dkar ser dmar ljang sngo ba'i rtsig pa rim pa lnga dang ldan pa/ rin po che'i pha gu ser po dang*/ dra phyed dang*/ shar bu dang*/ mda' yab kyis bskor ba/ rtsig pa'i phyi rol gyi 'gram du 'dod yon gyi snam bu dmar po la mchod pa'i gzungs ma rnams 'khod pa/ sgo khang rnams kyi steng du/ zur bzhi nas ka ba rnams kyis btegs pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi dang ldan pa'i rtse mor pad+ma la gnas pa'i 'khor lo dang*/ gdugs dang*/ ri dwags kyi gzugs brnyan dang bcas pa/ nang ka ba brgyad dang ldan pa'i steng gtsang khang phyur bur gyur pa'i dbus kyi rtse mo rdo rje rin po che tog gis brgyan pa/ 'og gzhi nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du khor yug nag po rim pa gnyis keng rus kyi 'phreng bas brgyan pa'i bar stongs kyi gzhi la dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyogs skyong ba dang*/ zhing skyong ba dang*/ shing dang*/ spṛn dang*/ me dang*/ chu dang*/ mchod rten dang*/ klu dang*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' bo dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ sha za dang*/ srin po dang*/ bya dang gcan gzan sna tshogs pas yongs su gang ba/ mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa'o/ /rgyan gyi rnam pa thams cad dang ldan pa'i gzhal med khang chen po'i nang gi lha rnams shar dkar/ lho ser nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ dbus sngo ba'i steng du 'khor lo sngon po rtsibs bzhi pa/ mu khyud la gri gug dang*/ thod skam gyi 'phreng bas bskor pa/ 'khor lo'i lte bar sna tshogs pad+ma'i steng du g.yas su tshangs pa dkar po dang*/ g.yon du brgya byin ser po kha bub tu gnas pa/ de gnyis kyi sogs phrag tu g.yas su zla ba dang g.yon du nyi ma'o/ / 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams la shar du dri za pho mo/ lhor gshin rje pho mo/

nub tu chu bdag pho mo/ byang du gnod sbyin pho mo rnams kha bub byin bcings su bsnol ba'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor re re'o/ /sgo bzhi'i sgo phugs kyi nang g.yas dang g.yon du zla ba'i gdan re re'ang grub par gyur/ dbus kyi gdan gyi steng du/ a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥ l̥̄ e ai o au aṃ aḥ g.yas skor dang g.yon skor phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor me long lta bu'i ye shes so/ /de'i steng du ka kha ga gha nga*/ tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra wa la/ sha ṣa sa ha k+ṣa/ ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha/ g.yas skor dang g.yon skor phrag gnyis zhu ba las byung ba'i nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes so/ /nam mkhar gnas pa'i rang sems hūṃ yig sgra dang bcas bzhin du nam mkha' nas babs te/ zla nyi'i bar du bzhugs/ de las thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ dpral ba la aṃ yig gis mtshan pa/ de'i nang du rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa thod par phyed tsam nub pa'i lte bar hūṃ gis mtshan pa ni so sor rtogs pa'i ye shes so/ /de las 'od zer gyi tshogs dpag tu med pa 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus/ rdo rje thod pa sa bon dang bcas pa la thim pa ni/ bya ba sgrub pa'i ye shes so/ /nyi zla sa bon phyag mtshan dang bcas pa ro gcig tu 'dres pa las/ sku yongs su rdzogs pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes so/ /de yang bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po phyag na rdo rje sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyis rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis rlabs pa/ sku mdog mthing nag dus mtha'i sprin dang mtshungs shing*/ glog 'phreng ltar rno zhing tsha ba'i kha rlangs 'byin pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa zhal mthing nag shin tu khros shing rngam pa/ a la la'i gad rgyangs 'brug sgra ltar sgrog pa/ g.yas zhal dkar po yid tsam 'dzum zhing bzhad pa/

g.yon zhal dmar po ya sos ma mchu mnan zhing ma rungs pa rnams zhe la mnan pa/ zhal re re la me stag gi phung po ltar dmar ba'i spyan gsum gsum dang*/ mi bzad pa'i mche ba rnon po bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zla ba nya gang ba ltar rab tu rgyas pa'i bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor khro gnyer bsdus shing*/ sma ra ag tshom smin ma me ltar 'bar ba/ dbu skra dmar ser gyen du brdzes shing rtse mor rdo rjes brgyan pa/ phyag drug gi g.yas kyi dang pos 'bar ba'i rdo rje rtse lnga pa rwa gdengs pa 'phyar zhing gsor ba/ g.yon dang po sdigs mdzub kyis gdug pa can ma lus pa sdigs shing gsod pa/ phyag bar pa gnyis yum la 'khyud tshul gyi thal mo brdabs pas ri rab gzhig cing*/ bdud kyi 'jig rten mtha' dag rlag par mdzad pa/ phyag tha ma gnyis kyis klu rgyal gdug pa sbrul nag po'i gzugs can re re sked pa nas btsir te/ sta zur g.yas g.yon gyi thad ka nas 'dzin zhi nga mgo bo rtsa zhal du gsol nas mjug ma zhabs gnyis kyis 'og tu mnan pa/ sku sbom zhing thung la gsus khyim che ba/ zhabs g.yas bskum pas tshangs pa dang zla ba mnan zhing*/ g.yon brkyang bas brgya byin dang nyi ma brdzis pa/ stag gi pags pa'i smad dkris brla'i steng du 'phyang zhing*/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs can/ nor rgyas dang dung skyong rgyal rigs ser pos dbu rgyan/ dga' bo dang gnyen dga' rje rigs dmar pos snyan cha/ pad+ma dang chu lha bram ze'i rigs dkar pos dpung rgyan/ stobs rgyu dang rigs ldan dmangs rigs nag pos tshangs skud dang*/ ske rags byas pa ste gdug pa'i sbrul rnams kyis sku la brgyan pa'o/ /thod skam gyi dbu rgyan/ mi mgo'i do shal/ rin po che'i cod pan la sogs pa cha byad thams cad yongs su rdzogs pa/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ / de ltar rang nyid dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar nyi ma'i gdan la sangs rgyas kyi gos sngon can mi bskyod pa sngon po/

g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'phyar ba/ g.yon sdigs mdzub thugs kar gtod pa/ zhabs g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang pas bzhengs pa ni ye shes sems dpa'o/ /de'i yang thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du rdo rje rtse lnga pa lte ba la hū ཾ gis mtshan pa me 'bar ba ni/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'o/ /gtso bo bcom ldan 'das kyi pang du yum lha mo mdzes ldan ma sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig khro ma 'dzum gyi rnam pa can/ phyag g.yas rdo rje gri gug nam mkha' la 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon thod pa dmar gyis gang ba 'dzin pas gtso bo'i mgul nas 'khyud pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du brdzes shing spyan gsum pa/ rus pa'i rgyan drug dang ldan pa/ thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal can/ zhabs g.yas brkyang zhing*/ g.yon yab kyi sku la 'khril ba/ bde ba chen po'i dga' bas brgyan pa'o/ /de nas 'khor gyi lha tshogs spro bar bya ste/ yab kyi gsang gnas hū ཾ las byung ba'i rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa hūṃ gis mtshan zhing rtse mor phaṭa kyis brgyan pa/ yum gyi mkha' aḥlas byung ba'i pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma gsum pa aḥyig gis mtshan pa/ yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i rkyen gyis bskul bas thugs ka'i hūṃ las 'od 'phros/ mkha' dbyings gang ba'i sangs rgyas 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad spyan drang zhal du zhugs/ sku'i dbyibs brgyud/ thugs kar rjes chags kyi mes yongs su zhu/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar babs pa byang chub kyi sems dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs can gyi phung por gyur/ de nyid cha bcu drug pa gnyis su gyur/ cha brgyad thig le dkar dmar nyi zla kha sbyor gyi rnam pa bzhir gyur/ cha bzhi yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje dang*/ bzhi yongs su gyur pa las thod par gyur/ thod khrag gi nang du rdo rje phyed nub tsam cha bzhi mkha' nang nas phyir spros te/ 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhi la 'khod/ oṃ badz+ra s+pha ra ṇa hū ཾ phaṭa/ lan brgyad/ shar du khro bo chen po bdud las rgyal byed sku mdog dkar po phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje/

g.yon dang po 'khor lo'i lte ba nas yar bton pa'i mdung rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa la/ yum 'od zer can ma dkar mo g.yas spu gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yo thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa'o/ /lho phyogs su khro bo gzi brjid mtha' yas sku mdog ser po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas kyi dang po rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon rin po ches mtshan pa'i dbyug pa bsnams pa/ yum mdangs ldan ma ser mo g.yas rdo rje zangs gri dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khrud pa/ gshin rje pho mo zhabs kyi 'og tu gnon pa'o/ /nub tu khro bo rngam pa'i sgra sgrog sku mdog dmar po/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang pos rdo rje 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang pos pad+ma dmar po dang sbrul zhags 'dzin pa/ 'dir pad+ma dmar pos mtshan pa'o/ /sbrul zhags zhes phal cher 'chad kyang*/ sbrul zhags la pad+mas mtshan pa mi bde bas dkyus ltar bya'o/ / yum sgra dbyangs can ma li khri'i mdog can g.yas dgra sta dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ chu lha pho mo zhabs kyis gnon pa/ byang du khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag bzhi'i g.yas dang po rdo rje rtse lnga 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon dang po sna tshogs rdo rjes mtshan pa'i be con 'dzin pa/ yum rlung 'byin ma sna tshogs mdog can nam ljang khu phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang*/ g.yon thod khrag 'dzin pas 'khyud pa/ de ltar khro bo bzhi po thams cad phyag 'og ma gnyis thugs kar sdigs mdzub bsnol ba'i phyag rgyas rang rang gi yum la 'khyud pa/ stag lpags kyi smad dkris dang/ dar sngon po'i stod g.yogs dang*/ sbrul gyi rgyan dang*/ mi mgo skam rlon gyi do shal la sogs pa rgyan dang cha byas bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i bdag po nyid dang mtshungs shing*/ zhabs g.yon brkyang gi stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ /khro mo bzhi po rnams kyang gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan can thod skam gyi dbu rgyan dang do shal 'phyang ba/ g.yas brkyang gi stabs kyis rang rang gi thabs dang sbyor ba sogs cha byad thams cad bcom ldan 'das ma dang mtshungs pa'o/
/oṃ s+pha ra ṇa

hū ཾ phaṭa/ lan brgyad brjod/ mkha' nang du gnas pa'i thig le cha lhag ma brgyad phyir spros te/ sgo bzhi'i zla ba'i gdan rnams su 'khod pa sgo skyong rnams su gyur pa ni/ shar gyi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon du lcags kyu ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog dkar ba/ phyag gnyis lcags kyu bsnams pa'o/ /lho'i sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje zhags pa dang*/ g.yon du zhags pa ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog ser po phyag gnyis zhags pa 'dzin pa'o/ /nub gyi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje lcags sgrog dang*/ g.yon du lcags sgrog ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog dmar ba phyag gnyis lcags sgrog 'dzin pa'o/ /byang gi sgo khyud kyi nang gi g.yas su rdo rje dril bu dang*/ g.yon du dril bu ma ste gnyis kar yang sku mdog ljang khu/ phyag gnyis dril bu 'dzin pa dang*/ sdigs mdzub mdzad pa'o/ / de thams cad kyang stag spags dang*/ sbrul rgyan can yab rnams g.yon bskum g.yas brkyang dang*/ yum rnams g.yas bskum g.yon brkyang bas gnas pa'o/ /sgo skyong 'di rnams kha sbyor gyi sku can ma yin/ yab yum so sor zhal sprod du bzhugs pa yin/ 'di dag la thig le las so so'i phyag mtshan du gyur nas bskyed pa'i lugs yod pa ltar byas kyang 'gal ba med do/ /de ltar 'khor bco brgyad po thams cad kyang spyan gsum pa mche ba gtsigs pa khro gnyer bsdus pa skra ser gyen du brdzes pa/ gar gyi nyams dgu dang ldan zhing*/ gdul dka' ma lus pa 'dul bar mdzad pa/ khro bo dang khro mo'i cha byad yongs su rdzogs shing sangs rgyas thams cad kyi 'phrin las mdzad pa'o/ /de dag ni dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ro/ /de nas rang gi thugs ka'i hū ཾ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas gsang ba'i bdag po'i ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor byon pa dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa sras dang bcas pa thams cad gcig tu 'dus pa rnams ro mnyam du 'dres te/

dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ ma lus sems can= nas/ bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang = zhes pa nas/ mchod pa bla na med pas mchod kyi bar/ gong tshogs zhing gi skabs ltar phyag mchod bya/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ lha thams cad kyi spyi bor zla ba la oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par pad+ma la āḥdamar po/ snying gar nyi ma la hūṃ mthing nag go /de rnams las 'od zer 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi byin rlabs dang*/ nus mthu thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par tshur bsdus te/ gnas gsum gyi yi ge 'bru gsum la thim / yang thugs ka'i hū ཾ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas sangs rgyas thams cad dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pas rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥ hū ཾ = sogs nyer spyod lngas mchod/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis bdag la rigs shes par bya ba'i phyir dbang bskur du gsol/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu maṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rdo rje dang 'khor lo la sogs pa'i mtshan ma dang lhan gcig ye shes kyi bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa phyag tu bsnams pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis oṃ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ lha rnams ky-is ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka te sa ma ya shre ye hū ཾ / zhes gsungs shing*/ dbang bskur bas byang chub kyi sems kyi chu rgyun gyis sku lus gang*/ sgo gsum gyi dri ma thams cad sbyangs/ gtso 'khor thams cad la dbang rtags su rgyal ba mi bskyod pa re res dbu rgyan par gyur/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ gsal zhing dwangs la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/

/rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ zhes brjod la/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams snang stong gnyis su med par thos/ yang tshogs zhing gi skabs bzhin/ ar+ghaṃ?= nas shabha 'i bar gyi mchod pa phul/ hūṃ de nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir/ /rdo rje me dpung 'od dang ldan// de nyid mkha' dang 'byung ba las/ /dur khrod brgyad dang ldan pa'i gnas/ / hū ཾ thabs dang shes rab sbyor ba yi/ kha sbyor nyi zla'i 'phro 'du las/ / bgegs rigs stong phrag 'joms mdzad pa'i/ /'khor lo'i bdag por phyag 'tshal bstod/ thabs dang sogs tshigs rkang gong ma gnyis 'dra ba las/ dri za gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /bdud las rgyal la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gshin rje gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje gzi brjid phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chu lha gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rngam pa sgra sgrog phyag 'tshal bstod/ /gnod sbyin gdug pa 'dul mdzad pa'i/ /rdo rje las la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / hū ཾ 'byung ba lnga'i bdag nyid che/ /mdzes ldan 'od zer can ma dang*/ /mdangs ldan sgra dbyangs rlung 'byin te/ /skyed byed las kun sgrub la bstod/ /bka' nyan pho nya las mdzad pa/ /lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril/ /'gugs shing sdud dang sdoms dang 'dzin/ /mtha' 'dul las kun sgrub la bstod/ nang mchod dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta ku ṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa kyis bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shu d+dha sarba dharma swa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ gis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las 'og tu yaṃ las rlung de'i steng du raṃ las me/ de'i steng du kaṃ las thod skam gyi sgyed pu gsum/ de'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dum bu gcig pa/ phyi dkar la nang dmar ba yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las glang po che'i sha byang du ha las rta'i sha de rnams kyi steng na/ shar du be las dri chen/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ nub tu shu las byang sems/

byangadu ma las klad pa rnams ye shes lnga'i ngo bo/ de rnams kyi steng du oṃ mgo bo thur du bstan pa/ de'i steng du a las byung ba'i zla ba la gnas pa'i rdo rje hū ཾ gis mtshan pa/ hū ཾ de las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros/ rlung g.yos me sbar rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol ba kha dog dmar por gyur/ yang hū ཾ las 'od 'phros/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ rdo rje hūṃ ldan la thim/ de zla ba la thim/ de oṃ la thim/ oṃ yig dam rdzas la thim pas kha dog dri ro nus mthu phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥ hūṃ lan mang du brjod/ sangs rgyas rdo rje 'chang chen po'i zhal du i dam a mṛ ta mahā swa da hū ཾ / phyag na rdo rje mkha' 'gro seng gdong ma/ /grub thob sa ba ri dang dza ba ri/ /de ba pur+ṇa gar lo chos kyi bzang*/ /rin chen dngos grub smar ston chos rgyal dang*/ /sgang ston sher bla jo sras sher 'bum dang*/ /shug sbug sngags 'chang <khru ston shes rab grub zer3gt; gru ston rdo rje seng*/ /bcom ldan rig ral zhang sgom zhig <rin rgyal3gt; po dang*/ sangs rgyas <'jam dbyangs3gt; dpal dang kun mkhyen dge 'dun bzang*/ rgyud 'dzin sangs rgyas brag dkar sems dpa' dang*/ bsod nams rgyal mtshan rje btsun rdo rings dbon/ /rtsa ba'i bla ma dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon/ /'khrid lung bshad rgyud bla ma rnams la mchod/ i dam= sogs sbyar/ yang chos kyi bzang = zhes pa'i rjes la/ gshen rigs ston pa rin chen dngos grub dang*/ /chos kyi rgyal mtshan shes rab rdo rje dang*/ /thub pa shes rab brtson 'grus seng ge dang*/ /chos rgyal shes rab grub ste smar ston drug /rin chen seng ge mkhas mchog rin chen grub// rgyal ba chos grub bka' bzhi rin rgyal ba/ /dkon mchog dpal bzangadon grub rgyal mtshan dang*/ /bkra shis rgyal mtshan dpal ldan chos bzang sogs/

dbang rgyud bla ma rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ yang brtson 'grus seng ge'i rjes la/ chos kyi rgyal po zhes te smar ston lnga/ /gan chag dbang rgyal mjims chen rgyal mtshan dpal/ /kun mkhyen chen po sa bzang paṇa chen sogs/ /byin rlabs brgyud pa rnams la mchod pa 'bul/ brgyud pa 'di'i 'phros 'khrid dang tshig brgyud ni 'phags pa kun bzang/ brag dkar byang sems/ sems dpa' bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ mkhan chen bkra shis rnams/ rje btsun grol mchog rje lha dbang grags pa rnams so/ / oṃ nī lam+bar dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hri da ya mahā kro dhā satwa hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa/ i dam= sogs so/ 'di nyid kyi rdzogs rim dngos rnams sgom par 'dod na skabs 'dir bsgom/ bzlas pa ni/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho pa na nā ga pa dhi pa ta ye i dam nī lā ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da ta yaṃ ya/ sa ma ti/ kra ma ti/ uta pa dā naṃ/ bha wi ṣ+ya ti hūṃ hūṃ/ zhes pa 'di gtso bo'i rgyun sngags so/ / oṃ pa ra kra mā ya phaṭa/ kri tān ta ya phaṭa/ kri tān ta ru pā ya phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya phaṭa/ /bi dha ra ṇā ya phaṭa/ kro dha satwa nā ya phaṭa/ nī la ba sa nā ya phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la ya phaṭa/ de dag ni khro bo yab bzhi yum bzhi'o/ /oṃ ha ra ha ra/ dha ra dha ra/ pra ha ra pra ha ra/ mā ra ya mā ra ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo ba bzhi'i 'o//tshin+dha tshin+dha/ bhin+dha bhin+dhā/ / ha sa ha sa/ nā sha ya na sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo ma bzhi'i sngags te/ bsnyen pa'i skabs gtso bo la bzhi 'bum/ 'khor la bzhi khri/ zhes 'chad pa dang*/ yang dkyil 'khor 'bri ba sogs kyi don la/ gtso bo la bzhi khri/ 'khor la bzhi stong gis kyang chog par 'dod pa'ang yod mod kyang*/ sngar dkyil 'khor gzhan gyi bsnyen pa ma song na bzhi 'bum nyid bzla ba legs/ yang bsnyen pa'i dus gtso bo'i rgyun bzlas kho na byed cing*/ bsnyen sgrub sgrel ba'i dus gtso 'khor sgrags te bzla'o zhes 'dod pa'ang yod mod kyi/

lag len du/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi mahā kro dha satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa'i nye snying bzhi khri sogs ji ltar 'os pa sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra badz+ra pā ṇi hṛ da ya mahā kro dha satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ ces pa la 'bru 'bum song na rab/ ma tha yang bzhi 'bum bzla'o/ /de nas gtso bo'i rgyun sngags kyang bzhi 'bum mam bzhi khri sogs bzlas kyang legs mod kyi/ de bas kyang rtsa sngags yongs rdzogs nyid bzla ba bzang ste/ bzlas pa'i gtso bo snying po dang rtsa sngags gang rigs shig la byed rgyu yin pas so/ / de la rtsa sngags ni/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho pa na nā ga a dhi pa ta ye/ i dam nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra sha rī raṃ/ badz+ra pā ṇi hri da yaṃ ya/ sa ma ti kra ma ti/ ma ku la/ uta pa ta naṃ/ bha wi ṣ+ya ti/ tad+ya thā/ bud+dha bud+dha/ bi bud+dha bi bud+dha/ ma ti kra ma thā/ ha ra ha ra nā ga nā ཾ / pra ha ra pra ha ra nā ga nāṃ/ tshin+dha tshin+dha nā ga hri da ya ni/ bhin dha bhin dha nā ga marma ṇi bi shir+yān+tu/ nā ga sha rī ra ṇi/ bi s+pho ṭa ya nā ga nā ya ni/ tad+ya thā hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga bi ra cha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nā ga ud sa da na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ nī la ba sa na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ a pra ti ha ta ba la pa ri kra ma ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kri tan tā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kri tan ta rū pa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ro ṣa ṇa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ trā sa nā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ kum+bhaṇ+ḍa uta sa ta na ya hūṃ phaṭa/ pre ta pi shā tsa bi nā sha ka rā ya hūṃ phaṭa/ yak+ṣaX a pa sma ra bi nā sha ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ ha sa ha sa/ dha ra dha ra/ mā ra ya/ mā ra ya/ nā sha ya/ nā sha ya/ sarba bi gh+nān/ bi nā sha ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sarba sha trun sang gha bi nā sha ka ra ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nī lāṃ ba ra dha ra/ badz+ra pā ṇi dha ra dzñā pa ya ti swā hā/ de ltar ci nus su bzlas pa'i mthar yang gong bzhin mchod bstod bya/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ khams gsum snod bcud thams cad dpal phyag na rdo rje rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur/

de thams cad bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin dgyes pa chen pos 'od du zhu/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la thim/ srung 'khor gzhal yas khang dang bcas pa yang lha bco brgyad la thim/ sgo ma bzhi dang khro mo bzhi gtso mo la thim/ sgo skyong bzhi dang khro mo bzhi 'khor lo'i dbang phyug gi thugs kar thim/ bcom ldan 'das ma yang gtso bo'i thugs kar zhugs/ dpal gsang ba'i bdag po'i sku snang stong bde ba'i rang bzhin can de yang 'od gsal ba'i dbyings su thim/ zhes cung zad mnyam par bzhag slar yang rang nyid gsang ba'i bdag po phyag gnyis pa'i skur gyur/ dpral par oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag ces sogs dang*/ gzhan yang byang chub tu bsngo ba sogs ji ltar 'os pa byas te/ thun mtshams la 'jug go / thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ gtor ma bcu gsum mam/ lnga'am/ gsum mam/ bsdu na gcig bsham zhes gong ma rnams gsung pa ltar yin la/ klu la dkar gtor cig bsham na legs/ gzhan dmar gtor bya/ mchod pa'ang bshams/ a mṛ ta sa bsangs/ swa bha wa sa sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ hūṃ zhu ba las 'byung ba'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ zhal bsil/ me tog / bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams bzang zhing rgya che ba nam mkha'i mtha' klas par 'gyur/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swāhā/ de bzhin du/ pā d+yi añtsa ma naṃ/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūṃ de bzhin du shabha 'i bar du sbyar/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍa ra ṇi ta= sogs/ gtor ma byin rlabs gong du bshad pa'i nang mchod byin rlabs dang 'dra/ gtor mgron bskyed tshul la phyi rol maṇ+ḍal mchod pa mchod pa dang 'brel ba'i dbang du byas nas/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab brgyad la lha bco brgyad/ de'i phyi rol dma' bar pad+ma dmar po 'dab brgyad la klu brgyad/ de'i phyi rol sna tshogs 'dab ma bcu drug la/ gnod sbyin brgyad dang bdud brgyad de dam can nyer bzhi de ltar bskyed par 'chad mod/

de ltar byas kyangalegs mod kyi/ dkyus kyi nyams len la dkyil 'khor yongs rdzogs skad cig gis bsgoms nas/ klu dang gnod sbyin bdud sogs dur khrod du gnas par bsgoms te/ gtor ma phul ba'i chog go /de nas maṇ+ḍal mchod pa'i gtor ma dang/ phyi rol gtor ma dang*/ rgyun 'khyer gtor chog ste gsum po dbye ba phyed dgos shing*/ dkyil 'khor chen po'i nang gtor rgyun 'khyer dang 'dra'o/ /'dir de lta bu'i dbang byas nas/ bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ mdun gyi nam mkhar chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang du rdo rje'i sa gzhi'i steng dbus su gzhal med khang gdan dang bcas pa/ mtha' skor dur khrod chen po brgyad/ phyi rol bsrungs ba'i 'khor los bskor ba dang bcas pa grub par gyur/ tad+ya thā/ bho bho= nas/ ṣ+ya ti hūṃ hūṃ/ dbus su bcom ldan 'das dpal phyag na rdo rje yab yum bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ pa ra kra ma=

nas/ ba la ya phaṭa/ shar du khro bo bdud las rgyal ba dang 'od zer can ma/ lhor gzi brjid mtha' yas dang mdangs ldan ma/ nub tu rngam pa sgra sgrog dang sgra dbyangs ma/ byang du bdud rtsi 'khyil ba dang*/ rlung 'byin ma rnams bzhugs par gyur/ oṃ ha ra ha ra= nas/ nā sha ya hūṃ phaṭa/ sgo bzhir lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril bu yab yum rnams bzhugs par gyur/ dur khrod kyi sa gzhi la klu dang*/ gnod sbyin bdud de drag po sde gsum rnams 'khod pa ni/ phuḥyig las byung ba'i klu brgyad dang*/ k+ṣaḥyig las byung ba'i gnod sbyin brgyad dang*/ hūṃ yig las byung pa'i bdud rgyal brgyad kyang 'khod par gyur/ steng gi nam mkha' la rtsa rgyud kyi bla ma rnams dang*/ /sangs rgyas byang sems 'phags pa'i tshogs thams cad bzhugs par gyur/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros/ dpal 'khor lo chen po'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha tshogs la/ bla ma dkon mchog dam can srung ma'i tshogs thams cad kyis bskor ba badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūṃ baṃ hoḥ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūṃ/ spros pa la mos na dbang bskur rgyas btab kyang byed de/ dam can rnams la gsang bdag phyag gnyis pa res dbu brgyan/ bsdu na mi dgos/ oṃ āḥ twa rat+na ku ru hūṃ/ te dzo ba ling ta kha kha khā hi kha hi/ lan bdun/ oṃ āḥbud+dha dharma sad+gha hūṃ/ ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ zhes lan gsum/ ar+ghṃ= nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyi mchod/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku/ sogs sho lo ka gcig dang*/ mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa/ sogs gsum gyis bstod/ bla ma dam pa dang dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum gyis bdag la byin gyis rlob cing thugs rjes bzung ste/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ma lus pa stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab/ gtor ma dang po'o/ / tad+ya thā bho bho= nas/ ṣ+ya ti hūṃ hūṃ i daṃ ba la ིཾ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan bdun/ oṃ pa ra kra ma= nas/ nā sha ya hūṃ hāṃ phaṭa/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum gyis dkyil 'khor ba rnams la 'bul/ ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shabha 'i bar gyis mchod/ phyag na rdo rje drag po che/ /rdo rje khro bo drag chen 'joms/ /rdo rje mi thub 'jigs byed che// rdo rje gzi brjid sngags kyi gtso/ /rdo rje 'phrin las don kun mdzad/ /thabs 'dul 'khor lo che la 'dud/ ces dang*/ de nas 'byung ba lnga yis= nas/ las kun sgrub la bstod/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la/ nas/ yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog gtor ma gnyis pa'o/ / nor rgyas dung skyong ser po shar/ /dga' bo nye dga' dmar po lho/ /pad+ma chu lha dkar po nub/ /stobs rgyu rigs ldan nag po byang*/ /thams cad gdengs ka bdun dang ldan/ /thal mo sbyar ba'i tshul gyi gnas/ /dga' rab dbang phyug thal ka 'khor lo 'dzin/ /me tog ma ni smug nag lcags kyu bsnams/ /thod 'phreng can ni nag po ral gri 'dzin/ /mdzes ldan ma ni sngaun mo gri gug bsnams/ /bum pa'i rna ba sngon po dgra sta 'dzin/ / 'od zer 'phrog ma dmar nag mi mgo bsnams/ /sen mo dgu pa nag po rdo rje 'dzin/ /mdangs 'phrog ma ni ljang nag rgyu zhags bsnams/ de ltar bdud rgyal yab yum thams cad ni/ /g.yon pa sdigs mdzub brkyang bskum tshul gyis bzhengs/ /bong bu'i rna ba thal ka ral gri 'dzin/ /sha za mo ni sngon po 'khor lo thogs/ /rna ba 'phyang ba dud kha dbyug tho 'phyar/ /ral pa can ma dmar mo mda' gzhu 'dzin/ ral pa gyen bsgreng dmar nag mdung thung bsnams/ /gdong ser ser mo gri gug brdeg pa'i stangs/ /ral gri'i so can nag po dgra sta 'phyar/ /seng ge'i gdong ma dud kha rtse gsum 'dzin/ /gnod sbyin de brgyad phyag g.yon thod khrag bsnams/ /kun kyang 'khor tshogs dpag tu med pas bskor/ oṃ nī lāṃ = nas/ kro dha satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ nā ga sa pā ri wa ra bā līṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/

lan gsum/ oṃ nī lāṃ= nas/ satwa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā pre ta sa pā ri wa ra ba ling ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ oṃ nī lāṃ= nas/ sa twa hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā yak+ṣa sa pā ri wa ra ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ lan gsum/ thun mong du/ a kā ro'i= sngags lan bdun sogs kyi phul/ slar yang ar+ghaṃ= nas/ shap+ta 'i bar gyis mchod/ brgya khrir zhabs bzhag 'jigs pa'i me/ /gad rgyangs bzhad mdzad zhal gsum pa/ /dang po'i zhal du gdug pa 'dzin/ /stobs chen rab tu gnon pa po/ /klu chen ma rung gdug pa can/ /nor rgyas dang ni dung skyong dang*/ /dga' bo dang ni 'jog po dang*/ /pad+ma chen po pad+ma dang*/ /stobs kyi rgyu dang rigs ldan dang*/ /rgya mtsho dag la gnas pa yi/ /klu dang sa bdag gnyan rnams ni/ /sprul pa las la grub pa yi/ /glen pa nga rgyal rdzu 'phrul can/ /sprul pa 'bum sde 'khor dang bcas/ / mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sha ི ga /bcom ldan mgon po zhal gsum pa/ / phyag drug rdo rje sdig pa g.yon/ /drag po'i thal mos skrag par byed/ /tha mas sbrul gdug ri rab mnan/ /mkha' la rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i bdud/ /dga' rab dbang phyug thod 'phreng can/ /bum rna sen dgu sha za'i bdud/ /gtsug na me tog mdzes ma dang*/ /'od zer 'phrog dang mdangs 'phrog ma/ /gdon rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i 'khor/ /ma lus 'khor bcas thams cad kun/ /mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes sha ི ga /bcom ldan mgon po= nas/ ri rab mnan gyi bar gong bzhin/ 'khor du gnod sbyin chen po ni/ /sha za rab 'jigs ral pa can/ / gdong ser seng ge gnod sbyin mo/ /bong bu'i rna ba rna ba 'phyang*/ /ral pa gyen bsgreng ral gri'i so/ /gnod sbyin 'khor te lnga brgyar bcas/ /dam rdzas gtor ma 'di long zhig ces dang*/ mchod sbyin gtor ma= nas/ kun 'grub shog gi bar brjod/ oṃ phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba= sogs dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis dang*/

yig brgya lan gsum/ ma 'byor pa dang = sogs/ khyod kyi sems can= nas/ badz+ra muḥgadug pa'i tshogs rnams ma lus 'dul ba dang / /sems can 'khor ba ma lus bsgral ba'i phyir/ /gsang ba'i bdag po 'phags pa gos sngon can/ / 'khor dang bcas pa bdag gis 'grub par shog /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig / sogs/ gzhan yang smon lam dang bkra shis ji ltar 'tsham par bya'o/ /'di'i sgos kyi gtor chog ni de tsam yin la/ chos skyong ye shes pa'i gtor bsngo gzhan byed na/ dkyil 'khor ba'i rjes drag po gsum gyi sngon la 'bul zhing*/ 'jig rten pa gzhan gyi gtor bsngo byed na/ drag po gsum gyi rjes su ma gtogs/ /sngon la byar mi btub/ lar yang 'dre phal pa nang gtor la 'jug pa ni legs rgyu med lags/ drag po gsum gyi rjes la/ 'khor lo bde mchog nas 'byung ba'i mkha' 'gro spyi gtor 'di mdzad pa gong ma rnams kyi phyag len du yang 'dug cing*/ shin tu gal che zhing legs pa'ang yin no/ /rnal 'byor gyi yan lag gzhan rnams ni/ gsang sngags bla med spyi dnga'adra ba'i phyir/ de dag gi rigs 'gre sbyar bas rung ba'i phyir 'dir ma smos so/ /bod yul 'dir gsang sngags gsar ma la yang phyag na rdo rje'i chos skor shin tu mang ste/ 'bro mar lugs kyi skor gos sngon can du grags pa dang*/ 'byung po 'dul byed kyi skor dang*/ gtum po khyung sham can gyi skor dang*/ u tsa'i chos skor dang*/ 'khor lo chen po'i skor dang*/ mdo lugs su grags pa'i skor dang*/ rdo rje be con gyi skor dang*/ rdo rje bde khros kyi skor dang*/ rdo rje me lce'i skor rnams la che ba dgur grags/ de dag tu mi gtogs pa sangs rgyas gsang bas mdzad pa sogs snga dar dang*/ stong nyid ting 'dzin gyis mdzad pa sogs phyi dar la 'gyur ba'i gzhung phra mo yang rnam grangs shin tu mang ba yod do/ /che ba dgu po rnams ci rigs pa la mkhas pa mang pos dpyad gzhir mdzad pa/

spyir rgya gzhung yin min the tshom can yang 'ga' re snang mod kyi/ chos skor 'di rnams bod yul du shin tu grags che zhing*/ thams cad la nus mthu mngon gyur du thob pa'i gsang sngags pa mang du byung ba kho na yin pas/ byin rlabs kyi gzi byin ches 'bar ba sha stag tu 'dug pas/ skur ba nam du yang mi btab cing*/ gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ / der ma zad che ba dgu po rnams la'ang 'ga' zhig la rgyud gzhung gnyis ka dang*/ kha cig la sgrub thabs la sogs pa'i gzhung 'ga' zung dai rgya dpe las bsgyur ba rtsod med du yod pa kho na yin pas/ cha lag gi gzhung phran thor bu pa rnams la bod rtsom yod du chug kyang zhal gdams yin pa'i phyir 'gal ba med de/ chos skyong mgon po so so'i gdams ngag gi dpe bum bzhin no/ /yangabyin rlabs med pa'i rgya gzhung las byin rlabs yod pa'i bod gzhung ngo mtshar chung ngu med pa'ang mkhyen par mdzod/ /khyad par du 'khor lo chen po'i chos skor 'di rnams mchog tu byin rlabs che zhing*/ rgyud gzhung rtsa ba rnams rtsod med yid ches can yin pas/ sngon gyi mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis zur za tsam gsungs zer yang snying po med/ bcom ldan rig ral dang*/ kun mkhyen chen po jo nang pa dang*/ bu ston rin po che dang*/ chos rje bla ma bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*/ rje btsun tsong kha ba chen po dang*/ bo dong ba chen po sogs bod yul rang gi shing rta chen po phyogs re tsam yin pa gzhung lugs thams cad la chos kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams kyis chos 'di la rtsis su mdzad pas rtsod pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /'khor lo chen po'i sgrubs thabs sbyar ba las/ /byung ba'i dge ba dri med gang bsags des/ /nam mkha'i khongs na gnas pa'i sems can rnams/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i go 'phang thob par shog/ // dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrubs thabs srid gsum 'dul byed ces bya ba 'di yang*/ /bla ma gong ma rnams kyi man ngag dang mthun par/

rgyal khams pa tā ra nā thas rnam 'byung gi lo'i dang po la sbyar ba'o/ / zhus dag/ maṅgalaṃ// mes po'i shul bzhag las/ tā ra nā tha'i gsung 'bum/dpal 'khor lo chen po'i sgrub thabs srid gsum 'dul byed bzhugs/ -PAGE 48--PAGE 49- -PAGE 44-
